purpose: Test whether strong within-species continuous flower-colour transitions from independent species are geographically concentrated in the same evaluable equal-area cells more than expected under the complete species-conditioned random-labelling pipeline.

input.scaling_source: calibration-only frozen means and population SDs from jbi-ch1-continuous-colour-representation-v1
input.measurement_evaluable_rule: feature_status == ok and continuous_colour_vector_z is non-null and finite
input.coordinates: frozen jbi_ch1_photo_split_v1.csv latitude/longitude joined by photo_id

species_transition_intensity.base_graph: symmetrized spherical k-nearest-neighbour graph within each species
species_transition_intensity.local_edge_filter: retain base-graph edges with great-circle distance <= the configuration max_edge_km
species_transition_intensity.edge_score: RMS Euclidean distance between frozen species-standardized continuous colour vectors
species_transition_intensity.edge_intensity: within-species average-rank transform of retained edge scores to [0,1] separately for each configuration and permutation
species_transition_intensity.edge_location: great-circle midpoint assigned to a fixed equal-area longitude-sin(latitude) cell
species_transition_intensity.species_cell_intensity: arithmetic mean of retained edge intensities whose midpoints fall in the cell

geometry_only_primary_selection.priority_rule: choose the first passing configuration by ascending max_edge_km, then by the listed finest-to-coarsest grid order
geometry_only_primary_selection.species_cell_detectable_rule: at least 2 retained geometry edges in that species/cell
geometry_only_primary_selection.failure_rule: if no configuration passes using coordinates and graph distances alone, report Stage B as not estimable and do not inspect colour-derived concentration statistics

shared_surface.detectability_denominator: A(x) = number of species with at least 2 retained geometry edges in cell x
shared_surface.shared_intensity: S(x) = arithmetic mean of species-cell transition intensities among detectable species
shared_surface.not_evaluable: cells with A(x) < 2 are NaN, never zero

primary_statistic.name: opportunity-weighted shared-transition concentration
primary_statistic.definition: weighted variance of S(x) over cells with A(x)>=2 using A(x) as the cell weight
primary_statistic.direction: larger values indicate stronger geographic concentration of shared transition intensity

null.secondary_two_sided_p_value: absolute deviation from the null mean, reported descriptively

sensitivity.configurations: all non-primary candidate configurations that independently pass the same geometry-only criteria
sensitivity.role: predeclared descriptive robustness only; the selected primary configuration remains the sole confirmatory Stage B test

interpretation.stage_b_rejects_shared_concentration_nul: evidence that independent species place relatively strong continuous flower-colour transitions in the same evaluable geographic cells more often than expected under species-conditioned random labelling
interpretation.next_if_supported: freeze a geographic reference library and test post-discovery correspondence without changing the discovered transition surface
interpretation.next_if_not_supported: retain Stage A local organization as the supported result and report no confirmatory evidence for cross-species shared-boundary concentration at the frozen spatial supports
